verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe found https://docs.getunleash.io/llms.txt live (HTTP 200) with an explicit 'Instructions for AI Agents' section. It tells agents to append `.md` to any page URL for clean Markdown, and the many docs citations served as .md pages corroborate this. Missing for 10: evidence of how complete the llms.txt index is (e.g., an llms-full.txt or full page listing), and independent reports of agents actually using these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: For clean Markdown of any page, append `.md` to the page URL
